segmente.text: The easiest way to sell something is to sell water to the thirsty.
What this means is that you need to understand what people are already looking for and where they are.
Most marketing fails because it tries to create demand.
Instead of identifying demand and simply channeling it.
So instead, go where the problem is already painful enough and where people need a solution for it.
Because with that, your offer will feel like relief, not like persuasion.
